description:
How would Adam Savage rate the classic sci-fi universes? Is there an alternative to either delegating a task or doing it yourself? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Gwen-Maker-of-Things, whom we thank for their support! What's your favorite sci-fi universe, and how good are you at delegating tasks, especially the supervisors out there?
